sources.title: He Garden
sources.excerpt: He Garden is a park in Yangzhou, Jiangsu province. He Family Garden, also known as Jixiao Villa, is the last but best work among the private gardens in Yangzhou. Located on Xuningmen Street, it is a heritage site under state protection and a national AAAA-rated tourist attraction. It is the best-known private garden of the late Qing dynasty, and is one of 20 first-class key parks in China. He Garden is considered a must-see place for tourists who travel in Yangzhou.
